name: Click Guide Visualizer
description: Draws a macro's upcoming inputs onto the level ahead of the player.

issues.info: Report bugs on the GitHub issues page.

show-guide.name: Show Guide
show-guide.description: Master switch for the whole overlay.

line-color.name: Guide Color
line-color.description: Colour used for player 1 bands and markers.

indicator-opacity.name: Indicator Opacity
indicator-opacity.description: Overall opacity of markers, the player line and the path.

fill-opacity.name: Fill Opacity
fill-opacity.description: Opacity of the shape interior, multiplied by the element opacity.

border-opacity.name: Border Opacity
border-opacity.description: Opacity of the outline, independent of the fill.

line-opacity.name: Line Opacity
line-opacity.description: Opacity of the white press and player lines.

line-width.name: Line Width
line-width.description: Width of the press line drawn inside a band.

show-player-line.name: Show Player Line
show-player-line.description: Draw a vertical line through the player to line up against bands.

line-lead-units.name: Line Lead (units)
line-lead-units.description: Move the player line forward, ahead of your position, in level units. 0 keeps it on the player.

line-lead-seconds.name: Line Lead (seconds)
line-lead-seconds.description: Move the line forward by a time gap instead. Added on top of the units value, and stays consistent through speed changes.

clip-bands-at-line.name: Clip Bands At Line
clip-bands-at-line.description: Off: bands disappear as you pass them. On: bands disappear as the lead line passes them, so nothing is drawn behind the line.

show-band-lines.name: Show Press Lines
show-band-lines.description: Draw the exact press instant inside each band.

cull-padding.name: Cull Padding
cull-padding.description: Extra level units drawn beyond the camera edge.

show-accuracy.name: Show Accuracy
show-accuracy.description: Show floating frame-difference labels when you click.

show-clicks.name: Show Click Markers
show-clicks.description: Draw a small box at each press point.

marker-row.name: Marker Row
marker-row.description: Vertical placement of markers when no height data is available.

learn-trajectory.name: Learn Trajectory
learn-trajectory.description: Remember heights observed on earlier runs and reuse them.

predict-heights.name: Predict Heights
predict-heights.description: Project forward physics to place markers. Costly and ignores pads and portals.

show-path.name: Show Predicted Path
show-path.description: Draw the projected trajectory line. Requires height prediction.

rhythm-mode.name: Rhythm Mode
rhythm-mode.description: Show a fixed on-screen column where notes fall toward a judgement line, instead of drawing bands into the level.

rhythm-hide-world-guide.name: Hide In-Level Guide
rhythm-hide-world-guide.description: While rhythm mode is on, stop drawing the bands and markers in the level itself.

rhythm-lead-time.name: Lead Time (seconds)
rhythm-lead-time.description: How far ahead notes appear, in seconds. Lower means they fall faster and are harder to read.

rhythm-lane-x.name: Lane Position
rhythm-lane-x.description: Horizontal position of the column on screen, as a fraction of screen width. 0.5 is centred.

rhythm-lane-width.name: Lane Width
rhythm-lane-width.description: How wide the column is, in pixels. Notes and the judgement line span the full width.

rhythm-hit-y.name: Judgement Line Height
rhythm-hit-y.description: Vertical position of the judgement line, as a fraction of screen height. 0.5 is the middle of the screen.

rhythm-note-thickness.name: Note Thickness
rhythm-note-thickness.description: How tall each note bar is, in pixels. Notes always span the full lane width.

rhythm-hit-effects.name: Hit Animation
rhythm-hit-effects.description: Play a burst animation when you hit a note, instead of the note just vanishing.

rhythm-hit-effect-time.name: Hit Animation Length
rhythm-hit-effect-time.description: How long the burst lasts, in seconds.

generate-from-level.name: Generate From Level
generate-from-level.description: Scan the level and work out the inputs with no macro file. Handles all eight gamemodes, portals and speed changes. Still approximate: it does not model pads, orbs or dual sections.

generate-speed.name: Starting Speed
generate-speed.description: Speed at the start of the level. Speed portals after that are detected automatically. 311.58 is normal 1x.

enable-cheats.name: Enable Cheats
enable-cheats.description: Master switch for every feature that changes how the game plays. Leave this OFF to use the mod purely as a visual guide, so your progress and completions stay legitimate. Nothing below this has any effect while it is off.

assist-buffer-input.name: Buffer Early Jumps
assist-buffer-input.description: Requires Enable Cheats. If you click slightly early, the jump is held and fired at the correct frame instead. It cannot rescue a late click - once the moment has passed the physics has already happened. Modifies your input, so a completion with this on is not legitimate.

assist-buffer-window.name: Buffer Window (seconds)
assist-buffer-window.description: How far ahead of a note an early click is still caught and held. Larger is more forgiving of early clicks.

assist-show-window.name: Show Buffer Window
assist-show-window.description: Draw the catch window ahead of the hit line. Only while cheats are enabled.

line-thickness.name: Player Line Thickness
line-thickness.description: Thickness of the vertical line through the player.

marker-size.name: Marker Size
marker-size.description: Edge length of a click marker box in level units.

show-releases.name: Show Releases
show-releases.description: Also draw a marker where each hold is released.

macro-file.name: Macro File
macro-file.description: Macro to visualise. Picking one here loads it immediately. Importing through the pause menu is usually easier.

auto-align.name: Auto Align
auto-align.description: Measure the offset between your clicks and the macro, then lock it in.

auto-load-macro.name: Auto Load Last Macro
auto-load-macro.description: Reload the most recently used macro on startup.

debug-log.name: Debug Logging
debug-log.description: Write extra diagnostics to the Geode log.
